metadata.description: Powerful tools for everyday development: CPF and CNPJ generators and validators, passwords, UUIDs and calculators.

home.title: Tools
home.intro: Generators, validators and calculators for everyday use, with an open API behind every tool. Find any of them with <kbd>Ctrl K</kbd>.

cpf.title: CPF
cpf.description: Generate valid CPFs for testing or validate a CPF.

cnpj.title: CNPJ
cnpj.description: Generate CNPJs or complete companies for testing, or validate a CNPJ.

rg.title: RG
rg.description: Generate valid RGs for testing or validate an RG.

cnh.title: CNH
cnh.description: Generate valid CNHs for testing or validate a CNH.

stateRegistration.title: State registration
stateRegistration.description: Generate valid state registrations for any state or validate one.

person.title: Person generator
person.description: Generate a person with name, documents, contact and a real address.

cep.title: CEP
cep.description: Generate real CEPs with an address or look up a CEP.
cep.keywords: generator lookup address zip postal code

licensePlate.title: License plate generator
licensePlate.description: Generate vehicle plates in the Mercosul or the old format.

uuid.title: UUID generator
uuid.description: Generate unique identifiers in the UUID v4 format.

creditCard.title: Credit card generator
creditCard.description: Generate valid cards for testing, with brand, expiry date and CVV.

bmr.title: BMR calculator
bmr.description: Calculate the Basal Metabolic Rate and daily calorie needs.

age.title: Age calculator
age.description: Find out the exact age from a date of birth.

discount.title: Discount calculator
discount.description: Calculate the discount amount and the final price.

numbers.title: Number picker
numbers.description: Draw one or more numbers within a range.
